title: 学习可以发生在下一件具体任务里

interpretations.headline: 学习可以发生在下一件具体任务里
interpretations.summary:
发展机会有时来自一件不大的任务，比如首次参与设计流程，或者把熟练的做法教给同事。这三题关注能否学习、使用专业技能并继续发展。

Development can start with a small task, such as trying a new process or explaining a skill you already use. The three items address learning, using existing skills and developing them.

guidance.text:
挑一项愿意试一试的新做法，找一个小任务应用。完成后问同事哪个环节值得保留，下次从那里接着练。

Choose a small task on which to try one new skill. Afterward, ask someone what worked and what you could build on next time.

limitations: 本维度由 3 个附录原项构成。各题按 0、25、50、75 或 100 计分，同权求均分。系统仅在答全时计算，未完成的答卷没有该分数。
得分越高，表示作答者在工作中学习、运用技能和继续发展的机会更多。结果描述本次作答。可用证据限于该维度相关国际中版研究，项目不套用地方常模、风险分级和个人能力评级。

English items and the five response options come unchanged from Annex 1. This descriptive score is the mean of completed items when all items are answered. Higher scores indicate more of the characteristic named by the scale. Formal risk assessment and clinical interpretation require separate information.
report.disclaimer: 用于成年工作人群的非商业研究和自我回顾。请结合具体情境理解。 For non-commercial research with adult workers and personal reflection.
